easy_workload: Two equations, two x/y coefficient columns plus RHS column; 70 new sample records, five batch records, easy source replays and pairs inspected
moderate_workload: Two or three equations, three x/y/z coefficient columns plus RHS; 28 new records checked
operators: Addition/subtraction, integer scalar coefficients, equality and matrices only; no solving or row reduction
limits: Coverage omissions and overfixed signs fail source/variety separately; this check only certifies no added prerequisites or workload in tested outputs.
